When a key may be exposed, rotate it.

Note: Rotation does not revoke issued tokens.

Important: Keep the old key until clients switch.

Rotate the key

Console

Go to the key Keys page.

gcloud

example keys rotate --key=k1

REST

Call the rotate method.
